I originally posted this to /v/ideasforvoat where it was suggested that this might be a more suitable subverse to post it in. To reproduce: Open an embedded gif, for example - https://voat.co/v/gifs/comments/405247, close the expando, open Devtools and go to Network, wait 10-15 seconds (probably whatever the length of the loop). The process doesn't end, it just keeps repeating like you never closed it in the first place. This bug isn't unique to Voat, RES has the same issue, but they don't even respond to bug reports so nobody bothers reporting them. I use CoreTemp so I see CPU/Memory/Temp in my system tray at all times. It's really a shame that closed gifs are draining resources in the background and most people will never notice.
